verses.greek_plain: ο κλεπτων μηκετει κλεπτετω μαλλον δε κοπιατω εργαζομενοσ ταισ χερσιν το αγαθον ινα εχη μεταδιδοναι τω χρειαν εχοντι
verses.english_web: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
verses.english_adapted: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

verses.greek_plain: πασ λογοσ σαπροσ εκ του στομα τοσ υμων
verses.english_web: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
verses.english_adapted: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

verses.greek_plain: 4 πα ση κακια
verses.english_web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
verses.english_adapted: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

verses.greek_plain: γινεσθε δε εισ αλληλουσ χρηστοι ευσπλα γχνοι χαριζομενοι εαυτοισ καθωσ ο θσ εν χω εχα ρισατο ημιν
verses.english_web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
verses.english_adapted: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: γινεσθε ουν μιμηται του θεου ωσ τεκνα αγαπητα
verses.english_web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
verses.english_adapted: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: και περιπατειται εν αγαπη καθωσ και ο χσ ηγαπησεν ημασ και παρεδωκεν εαυτον υπερ ημων προσφοραν και θυσιαν τω θω εισ οσμην ευω διασ
verses.english_web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
verses.english_adapted: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: πορνεια δε και ακαθαρσια πασα η πλεον εξεια μηδε ονομαζεσθω εν υμιν καθωσ πρεπει αγιοισ
verses.english_web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
verses.english_adapted: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

verses.greek_plain: και εσχροτησ και μωρολογια η ευτραπελια α ουκ ανηκεν αλλα μαλλον ευχαριστια
verses.english_web: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
verses.english_adapted: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: τουτο γαρ ειστε γινωσκοντεσ οτι πασ πορνοσ η ακαθαρτοσ η πλεονεκτησ ο εστιν ειδωλολατρησ ουκ εχει κληρονομεια εν τη βασιλεια του χριστου και θεου
verses.english_web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.english_adapted: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: μηδεισ υμασ απατατω κενοισ λογοισ δια ταυτα γαρ ερχε τε η οργη του θεου επι τουσ υιουσ τησ απιστιασ
verses.english_web: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
verses.english_adapted: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.
Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: μη ουν γινεσθε συμμετοχοι αυτων
verses.english_web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
verses.english_adapted: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.
Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: ητε γαρ ποτε σκοτοσ νυν δε φωσ εν κω ωσ τεκνα φωτοσ πε ριπατειτε
verses.english_web: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
verses.english_adapted: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

verses.greek_plain: ο γαρ καρποσ του φωτοσ εν παση αγα θοσυνη και δικαιοσυνη και αληθεια
verses.english_web: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
verses.english_adapted: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: δοκιμα ζοντεσ τι εστιν ευαρεστον τω κω
verses.english_web: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
verses.english_adapted: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

verses.greek_plain: και μη συγ κοινωνειται τοισ εργοισ τοισ ακαρποισ του σκοτουσ μαλλον δε και ελλεγχετε
verses.english_web: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
verses.english_adapted: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: τα κρυφη γινομενα υπ αυτων αισχρον εστιν και λεγειν
verses.english_web: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
verses.english_adapted: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

verses.greek_plain: τα δε παν τα ελλεγχομενα υπο του φωτοσ φανερουται
verses.english_web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
verses.english_adapted: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

verses.greek_plain: πιστεωσ και του κοπου τησ αγαπησ και τησ υπομονησ τησ ελπιδοσ του κυριου ημων ιυ χριστου εμπροσθεν του θεου και πρσ ημων
verses.english_web: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
verses.english_adapted: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: ειδοτεσ αδελφοι ηγαπημενοι υπο του θεου την εκλογην υμων
verses.english_web: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
verses.english_adapted: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

verses.greek_plain: οτι το ευ αγγελιον ημων ουκ εγενηθη εισ υμασ εν λογω μονον αλλα και εν δυναμει και εν πνευμα αγιω και πληροφορια πολλη καθωσ οι δατε οιοι εγενηθημεν εν υμιν δι υμασ
verses.english_web: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
verses.english_adapted: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

verses.greek_plain: και υμεισ μιμηται ημων εγενηθητε και του κυριου δεξαμενοι τον λογον εν θλιψει πολλη μετα χαρασ πνσ αγιου
verses.english_web: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.english_adapted: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

verses.greek_plain: ωστε γενεσθαι υμασ τυ πον πασιν τοισ πιστευουσιν εν τη μακεδονια και εν τη αχαια
verses.english_web: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
verses.english_adapted: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

verses.greek_plain: αφ υμων γαρ εξηχηται ο λογοσ του κυριου ου μονον εν τη μακεδονια και εν τη αχαια αλλ εν παντι τοπω η πιστισ υμων η προσ τον θεον εξεληλυθεν ωστε μη χρειαν εχειν ημασ λαλειν τι
verses.english_web: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.
verses.english_adapted: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.

verses.greek_plain: αυτοι γαρ περι ημων απαγγελλουσιν οποιαν εισοδον εσχομεν προσ υμασ και πωσ επεστρεψατε προσ τον θεον απο των ειδωλων δουλευειν θω ζωντι και αληθινω
verses.english_web: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
verses.english_adapted: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

verses.greek_plain: και αναμενειν τον υν αυτου εκ των ουρα νων ον ηγειρεν εκ των νεκρων ιν τον ρυομενον ημασ εκ τησ οργησ τησ ερχομενησ
verses.english_web: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
verses.english_adapted: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

verses.greek_plain: αυτοι γαρ οιδατε την εισοδο¯ 10
verses.english_web: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
verses.english_adapted: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

variants.note: Single-character difference in extant letters vs SR GNT.

verses.greek_plain: εξ ανθρωπων δοξαν ουτε αφ υμων ουτε απ αλλων
verses.english_web: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
verses.english_adapted: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

verses.greek_plain: δυνα μενοι εν βαρει ειναι ωσ χριστου αποστολοι αλλα εγενηθημεν νηπιοι εν μεσω υμων ωσ εαν τροφοσ θαλπη τα εαυτησ τεκνα
verses.english_web: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
verses.english_adapted: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

verses.greek_plain: ουτωσ ομειρομενοι υμων ευδοκουμεν μεταδουναι υμιν ου μονον το ευαγγελιον του θεου αλλα και τασ εαυτων ψυχασ διοτι αγαπητοι ημιν εγενηθητε
verses.english_web: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
verses.english_adapted: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

verses.greek_plain: μνημονευετε γαρ αδελφοι τον κοπον ημων και τον μοχθον νυκτοσ και ημερασ ερ γαζομενοι προσ το μη επιβαρησαι τινα υμων εκηρυξα μεν εισ υμασ το ευαγγελιον του θεου
verses.english_web: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
verses.english_adapted: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

verses.greek_plain: υμεισ μαρτυρεσ και ο θσ ωσ οσιωσ και δικαιωσ και αμεμπτωσ υμιν τοισ πιστευ σασιν εγενηθημεν
verses.english_web: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
verses.english_adapted: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

verses.greek_plain: καθαπερ οιδατε ωσ ενα εκαστον υμων ωσ πατηρ τεκνα εαυτου
verses.english_web: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
verses.english_adapted: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

verses.greek_plain: παρακαλουντεσ υμασ και παρα μυθουμενοι και μαρτυρομενοι εισ το περιπατειν υμασ αξι ωσ του θεου του καλουντοσ υμασ εισ την εαυτου βασιλειαν και δοξαν
verses.english_web: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
verses.english_adapted: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

verses.greek_plain: και δια τουτο και ημεισ ευχαριστουμεν τω θω αδιαλει πτωσ οτι παραλαβοντεσ λογον ακοησ παρ ημων του θεου εδε ξασθε 12
verses.english_web: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.
verses.english_adapted: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.
